articles.title: Anticipated Warhammer 40K tactical RPG Dark Heresy gets a release date
articles.summary: Owlcat Games has revealed a release date for its tactical role-playing sequel Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy. The game arrives 28th January, 2027 on PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series S/X. A Switch 2 release date will be provided "at a later date", a press release says. Read more
